name: Chugin Financial Group,Inc.
summary: Chugin Financial Group,Inc. provides banking services in Japan. It operates through Banking, Leasing, and Securities segments. The Banking segment offers financial services, such as deposit taking and lending services. The Leasing segment engages in leasing and installment sales of properties and goods. The Securities segment offers brokerage services for financial instruments. Chugin Financial Group,Inc. was incorporated in 2022 and is headquartered in Okayama, Japan.
